title: MacroPulse Alert
message:
FOMC Day 1: hike odds 91% (CME); decision tomorrow 2 PM ET (3.50–3.75% → 3.75–4.00%). 10y yield 5.025% — highest since 2007.
Clarity Act cloture vote 2:15 PM ET today — needs 60 Senate votes; Polymarket 14% odds, likely kills 2026 crypto legislation.
Oil: WTI ~$102.81 (+1.4% 24h), Brent ~$105; Middle East supply disruption sustained.
BTC ~$77,665; flat 24h, range-bound into FOMC.
